## What changes

<!-- One line per change. -->

## Checks

- [ ] The change applies to every repository the plugin runs in (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] No organisation data, secret or identifier added to tracked files.
- [ ] Guard rule changes include a test case proving the rule blocks.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run prove` fails on archived HEAD and passes on the tree for every fix.
- [ ] Corpus, generated artifacts and required CI checks pass.
- [ ] Native host support claims have fresh-session evidence.
- [ ] Review and checks cover the current PR head; stale results do not count.
